title: time field 60px hint tmm always visible
rule: Time field is fixed ~60px; hint `t.mm` always visible; component normalises to Finnish time — not placeholder-only format. Dual-cite USWDS time picker increments. Placeholder/label lock: format is not only in a placeholder.
pass_when: Time input is ~60px wide; `t.mm` hint is always visible; value is normalised to Finnish time.
fail_when: Time format lives only in a placeholder; field is far wider than the named ~60px with no always-visible hint.
overview: Time fields stay about 60px wide with an always-visible t.mm format hint.
apply_when: Building Suomi.fi time inputs that normalize to Finnish time.
not_when: Format living only in a placeholder, or oversized time fields with no lasting hint.
agent_hint: Keep the time field ~60px with a lasting t.mm hint; do not rely on placeholder-only format.
description: Suomi.fi time fields are fixed around 60px wide, keep a `t.mm` hint always visible, and normalize values to Finnish time. Format must not live only in a placeholder (placeholder/label lock). Dual-cite USWDS time picker increments for related timing patterns. A placeholder-only format or a much wider field without the lasting hint fails the pattern and hides the expected shape while typing.
do_not_claim: Date `PP.KK.VVVV` hint as this time row; USWDS increments as a merge.
